messages:
Elena (partnerships): Quick heads-up: platform team intends to deprecate the /v1/compat-proxy route that several partners rely on for SDK translations. Proposed removal date: 2026-05-15. Need outreach plan + compatibility guarantees.
Rajat (platform): Noted. Migration outline: (1) new /v1/generate endpoint + header mapping, (2) optional marketplace-hosted shim for slower partners, (3) partner-specific feature-flag for canary. We can run gateway rewrites for a transition window.
Maya (integrations): Who's impacted? Marketplace integrations, hardware OEMs with preinstalled SDKs, and a few systems integrators. I need a concrete diff (headers/params) to include in partner migration docs.
Sam (eng): Technical detail: compat-proxy handled KV-cache prefixing. New generate route preserves behavior but renames query params (dropping `compat=true`). We'll ship a transparent mapping layer for 30 days before removal.
Elena (partnerships): Good. I'll prepare partner comms and a rollback playbook. We should provide two migration options: quick SDK patch (minor release) or marketplace shim for partners needing extra time.
Rajat (platform): Draft schedule: announce 2026-04-01, start transparent rewrites 2026-04-15, partner canary 2026-04-22, retire shim 2026-05-15. Objections?
Maya (integrations): Schedule OK. I'll inventory partners and tag ones needing hands-on support. Recommend offering assisted migration slots for top 10 partners.
Sam (eng): Example migration snippet for partners:
```
# old
curl -H "X-Compat-Proxy: true" https://api.redwood.com/v1/compat-proxy/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# new
curl -H "X-RW-SDK-Mode: legacy" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
We'll provide python/js/go patches and a tiny compatibility client.
Elena (partnerships): I'll draft the email and tracking sheet. Maya, add partner priority tiers and attach any marketplace listing IDs.
Maya (integrations): Done. I've pinged AcmeHW and CloudPartner for early canary slots.
VendorBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PLT-523 for compatibility shim, documentation, and partner outreach.
Sam (eng): Also: eng-sre should add smoke tests for KV cache semantics and increase logging for the canary.
Rajat (platform): I'll own the canary dashboard and the rollback toggle. Propose automatic fallback to legacy path if error rate > 10 errors/min during canary.
Elena (partnerships): Great. Next sync: Tue 2026-03-30 09:30 PT. Notes & tasks -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PLT-523 :thumbsup:
Maya (integrations): :thumbsup:
Sam (eng): lgtm
Rajat (platform): lgtm
